title: Softborder
description: Softborder creates a worldborder beyond which the world can be easily reset
body:
Softborder is a utility mod that helps delete chunks at the edge of your world. It can create multiple custom borders and runs entirely server side.
There are 5 commands
- softborder create
- softborder remove
- softborder info
- softborder list
- softborder reset

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/GfT7cpNrTh4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

You can reset any dimension individually.
If a player is loading chunks they may fail to delete.
Players outside a border are kicked when reset is run.
